name: Homelessness
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/homelessness.json with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original draws each person's homelessness from United States statistics (HUD 2016, about 0.18% per year, repeated over a whole lifetime): 16.7% of patients were homeless at some point. It wrote a shelter encounter, a procedure, observations (including HIV status, sexual orientation and an abuse status) and the finding Homeless. The only other module that reads its output is covid19/determine_risk (homelessness_category, a marginal COVID risk factor); without the attribute a person is simply not homeless.
